The '''Ağrı Subregion''' ([[Turkish language|Turkish]]: ''Ağrı Alt Bölgesi'') (TRA2) is a statistical subregion in [[Turkey]].

== Provinces ==

* [[Ağrı Province]] (TRA21)
* [[Kars Province]] (TRA22)
* [[Iğdır Province]] (TRA23)
* [[Ardahan Province]] (TRA24)
